# EarthDoc

> EarthDoc is the EAGE's comprehensive geoscience research repository and journal platform providing peer-reviewed publications, conference proceedings, and digital resources for exploration geophysics, petroleum engineering, and applied geosciences.

EarthDoc serves as the central hub for the European Association of Geoscientists & Engineers (EAGE), offering access to multiple peer-reviewed journals, conference archives, and geoscience books. The platform supports both traditional hydrocarbon exploration and emerging energy transition topics including hydrogen storage and geoenergy.

## Key Topics

- EAGE (European Association of Geoscientists & Engineers)
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Geophysics and seismic imaging
- Petroleum engineering and exploration
- Conference proceedings
- Geoscience database and repository
- Applied geophysics
- Machine learning in geosciences
- Hydrogen storage
- Geoenergy and energy transition
- Open access publishing
- Near-surface geophysics
- Basin research
- Exploration geophysics
- Academic publishing

## Featured Journals

- [First Break](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/fb): Leading geoscience publication covering oil & gas, seismic analysis, and environmental topics
- [Geophysical Prospecting](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/gpr): Primary peer-reviewed research on geophysics for resource exploration and imaging
- [Petroleum Geoscience](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/petgeo): International journal on hydrocarbon exploration and sustainable development research
- [Near Surface Geophysics](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/nsg): Peer-reviewed research on applied near-surface geophysics and shallow subsurface investigations
- [Basin Research](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/bre): International peer-reviewed journal on sedimentary basin systems and geology
- [Geoenergy](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/geoenergy): Subsurface geoscience research for sustainable energy and energy transition applications
- [Exploration Geophysics](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/texg20): ASEG hybrid open-access journal on mineral and petroleum geophysics
- [Preview](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/texp20): ASEG flagship industry magazine on exploration geophysics and mining

## Research Collections

- [Conference Proceedings](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/proceedings): EAGE conference proceedings archive with filterable peer-reviewed research publications
- [Books](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/books): EAGE geoscience books catalog in digital formats including EPUB and PDF
- [First Break Journal Browse](https://www.earthdoc.org/content/journals/fb/browse): Browsable collection of First Break articles on seismic analysis and reservoir monitoring

## Access & Membership

- [EAGE Membership](https://www.earthdoc.org/eage-membership): EAGE membership information and benefits including EarthDoc database access
- [How to Subscribe](https://www.earthdoc.org/how-to-get-access): Subscription and access guide for institutions and individual members
- [Open Access Publishing](https://www.earthdoc.org/open-access): Gold open access publishing information and author benefits for peer-reviewed content

## About & Support

- [About EAGE](https://www.earthdoc.org/about-eage): EAGE organization overview, divisions, regional offices, and membership structure
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.earthdoc.org/faq): FAQ covering account access, search functionality, membership, and login instructions
- [EarthDoc Homepage](https://www.earthdoc.org): Main EarthDoc portal providing access to the EAGE geoscience database and research repository

## Optional

- [Privacy Statement](https://www.earthdoc.org/privacy): Privacy policy covering data collection, security, and user consent practices
